body:
I re-evaluated the final tree. The coverage gap is addressed:

- `Tests/UI/test_mcp_audit_identity.py` directly unit-tests `_unique_entry_key` across retained, absent, and ambiguous snapshots, including same-name tools on another server.
- The unmounted widget test verifies `_renew_entry_keys` never reuses keys from a retired snapshot.
- The existing `AuditApp.run_test` cases continue to exercise `_apply_filter`, `retire_selection`, event routing, filtering, duplicates, and departure behavior end to end.

This now provides both isolated unit coverage for the reconciliation primitives and integration coverage for their UI lifecycle. See the applicable rule: [View rule](https://app.qodo.ai/rules/497172?state=active).
